text: 国家发改委、国家能源局印发《“十五五”新型储能实施方案》。方案提出，科学布局新型储能创新方向。加快锂离子电池储能迭代升级，推广钠离子电池储能应用。推动压缩空气储能、液流电池储能、飞轮储能等从试点应用向商业化应用过渡。鼓励超级电容、压缩二氧化碳储能、液态空气储能、重力储能、熔盐储热等技术试点应用。支持固态电池、热泵储电、热储能、氢储能等前沿技术储备。
text_en: The National Development and Reform Commission and the National Energy Administration issued the "15th Five-Year Plan" Implementation Plan for New-Type Energy Storage. The plan proposes scientifically laying out innovative directions for new-type energy storage. Accelerate the iterative upgrading of lithium-ion battery storage and promote the application of sodium-ion battery storage. Drive compressed-air storage, flow battery storage, flywheel storage and others to transition from pilot applications to commercial applications. Encourage pilot applications of technologies such as supercapacitors, compressed CO2 storage, liquid air storage, gravity storage, and molten salt heat storage. Support the reservation of frontier technologies such as solid-state batteries, heat pump electricity storage, thermal storage, and hydrogen storage.
